I'm quite eager to use this card to purchase comprehensive travel insurance for an upcoming journey. I only have one past booking history and I think the booking id is insurance_12345. I believe my access privileges remain active as I recently acquired the token labeled 'token_abc123' yesterday. It's important that the coverage amounts to $1,500 which is what it will cost. Could we expedite this and use my booking record for booking_id, as I have an impending meeting?
